key_insight: Magenta closes the loop between informal mathematical reasoning and formal Lean verification by using Lean feedback to produce answers, validate statements, and repair failed proofs.
engineering_relevance: The pipeline is training-free and agentic, showing how verification signals can be integrated into LLM workflows to improve reliability on hard symbolic reasoning tasks.
method: Generate a natural-language answer, then formalize it as a Lean 4 statement.
Use a statement judge to check whether the formalization matches the original problem.
Route failures with an error-attribution judge to either mathematical re-derivation or local Lean repair.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 100% accuracy on evaluated olympiad benchmarks, including AIME 2025, AIME 2026, and HMMT February 2026, and solving all six IMO 2026 problems with K2-Horizon-7B.
watch_item: The approach depends on correct statement adjudication and repair routing, so performance may be sensitive to judge quality and could still admit false certificates if verification is imperfect.
paper_title: Magenta: Closing the Loop Between Mathematical Reasoning and Lean Verification
